sources.description: Assistant-authored seed; historical test already inspected

Assistant-authored Vietnamese challenge, written before v2 training. Not independent human evaluation. All splits frozen before model selection; calibration and test are disjoint. Public external test assesses booking in English and OOD in Vietnamese only.

sources.attribution: Larson et al., CLINC, An Evaluation Dataset for Intent Classification and Out-of-Scope Prediction (2019)
